boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named University of Houston spaces for studying, making, gathering, recreation, reflection, and attending campus events.

cards.title: M.D. Anderson Library
cards.subtitle: 4333 University Drive
cards.notes: Start at the main library for Special Collections, study areas, computer labs, printing, and other library services; check the current library hours before going.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library anchors several study and research options in one building.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Libraries identifies M.D. Anderson Library as its main campus library and home to Special Collections, with study spaces and technology services on site.
cards.source_title: Spaces & Technology | University of Houston Libraries
cards.access_notes: UH Libraries lists current building hours; services and access may vary by area.

cards.title: 24-Hour Lounge
cards.subtitle: M.D. Anderson Library
cards.notes: Use this round-the-clock library lounge when you need Wi-Fi, a place to focus or collaborate, vending, and nearby restrooms; bring your Cougar Card if required.
cards.short_summary: A library lounge designed for focus and collaboration at any hour.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Libraries states that the 24-Hour Lounge is open around the clock and offers students Wi-Fi, vending machines, restrooms, and space to focus or collaborate.
cards.access_notes: Open around the clock, according to UH Libraries; confirm any current entry requirements before arrival.

cards.title: Digital Research Commons
cards.subtitle: M.D. Anderson Library, Brown Wing Room 266-C
cards.notes: Book this library space for a small-group research session, a podcast recording, or a project using its specialized computers, software, and VideoWall.
cards.short_summary: An appointment-based library workspace for collaborative digital research and media projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Digital Research Commons provides UH community members group workstations, a lecture area, VideoWall, podcast studio, and research software.
cards.source_title: Digital Research Commons | University of Houston Libraries
cards.access_notes: By appointment only; reserve time through the UH Libraries request form.

cards.title: Student Center South
cards.subtitle: 4455 University Drive
cards.notes: Use the building directory and floor plans to find the Information Center, Games Room, CreationStation, student services, and reservable spaces before meeting a group.
cards.short_summary: A central student-services building with activity, support, and event spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: UH's Student Center directory lists services and venues in Student Center South, including the Games Room, CreationStation, Information Center, and conference services.
cards.source_title: Student Centers Directory | University of Houston
cards.access_notes: Located at 4455 University Drive; consult the Student Centers directory for individual office and venue availability.

cards.title: Student Center North
cards.subtitle: 4465 University Drive
cards.notes: Stop by when connecting with student organizations, student media, the Student Government Association, or international and veteran-support offices; verify office hours first.
cards.short_summary: A student-organization and campus-services hub next to Student Center South.
cards.evidence_claim: UH lists the Center for Student Involvement, Center for Student Media, Student Government Association, international services, and Veteran Services in Student Center North.
cards.source_title: Student Center North | University of Houston
cards.access_notes: Located at 4465 University Drive; office access and programming vary by department.

cards.title: Campus Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: 4500 University Drive
cards.notes: Complete the required annual waiver before your first visit, then use the recreation portal or app to check facility schedules and program availability.
cards.short_summary: The campus recreation facility supports fitness, intramurals, outdoor adventure, and wellness programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UH describes the Campus Recreation and Wellness Center as a facility for health, wellness, and community engagement, with programs including group fitness, intramural sports, and outdoor adventure.
cards.access_notes: An annual waiver is required before a first visit each academic year; check current facility hours and membership eligibility.

cards.title: Lynn Eusan Park
cards.subtitle: Central University of Houston campus
cards.notes: Walk through the tree-filled park between classes, or look for a scheduled campus gathering while learning about the student activist it commemorates.
cards.short_summary: A 4.6-acre central-campus park and memorial to UH student activist Lynn Eusan.
cards.evidence_claim: UH says Lynn Eusan Park is a 4.6-acre, tree-filled park in the center of campus that has served as a gathering spot for diverse groups since its 1976 dedication.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space; event activity and conditions vary.

cards.title: A.D. Bruce Religion Center
cards.subtitle: 3841 Cullen Boulevard
cards.notes: Check the event calendar or connect with a campus ministry when seeking a meeting, worship, meditation, or interfaith program in a welcoming campus setting.
cards.short_summary: An inclusive campus center for spiritual exploration, meetings, meditation, and faith-based organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: UH states that the A.D. Bruce Religion Center provides inclusive programming, events, and reservable spaces for meetings, worship, meditation, and more.
cards.source_title: A.D. Bruce Religion Center | University of Houston
cards.access_notes: Programs and reservable spaces have separate availability; see the center calendar or contact the office.

cards.title: Cullen Performance Hall
cards.subtitle: 4300 University Drive
cards.notes: Check the performance calendar for a concert, public lecture, theater production, or dance show, and follow event-specific ticketing and entry guidance.
cards.short_summary: A central-campus performance venue for concerts, lectures, theater, and dance.
cards.evidence_claim: UH states that Cullen Performance Hall hosts concerts, public lectures, theater performances, and dance shows in the center of campus.
cards.source_title: Cullen Performance Hall | University of Houston
cards.access_notes: Open to the public based on scheduled events; event entry and ticket requirements vary.

cards.title: Games Room
cards.subtitle: Student Center South, Room B30
cards.notes: Find the Games Room in Student Center South's basement when planning bowling, billiards, or eSports with friends; check its current operating details beforehand.
cards.short_summary: A named Student Center South recreation room with bowling, billiards, and eSports.
cards.evidence_claim: UH's Student Centers directory lists the Games Room in Student Center South, Room B30, and describes it as offering bowling, billiards, and an eSports room.
cards.source_title: Student Centers Directory | University of Houston
cards.access_notes: Located in Room B30; confirm operating hours and activity availability with the Student Centers.
